Why GTA 6 Took 13 Years to Come Out 😱
comment: Was GTA 6 worth the 13-year wait? Yes or no 👇
seo_intro:
Why did GTA 6 (GTA6) take 13 years? GTA 5 came out in 2013, and GTA 6 releases November 19, 2026.
Here's what we know: Red Dead Redemption 2 came out in between (2018), GTA 5 kept selling (230M+ copies), Rockstar officially delayed GTA 6 twice for quality, and the 2022 leak had no long-term effect on development.
tags: why did gta 6 take so long
sources: Tom's Guide / ESPN — GTA 6 delayed to May 26, 2026, then to November 19, 2026 (Rockstar: more time for quality)
Game Developer — GTA V surpasses 230 million sales (Take-Two, May 2026)
GameSpot / NME — Rockstar statement on the September 2022 leak: no long-term effect on development
